name: NUC LED Control
description:
Control the ring LED and power button LED on Intel NUC6CAY and NUC7i[x]BN from the top bar: on/off, brightness, color and blink/fade effect.

Requires the nuc_led kernel module and the LEDs set to "SW control" in the BIOS. Install instructions: https://github.com/ijiki16/intel-nuc-led
